# Setup

```{r packages}
#devtools::install_github("EcoDynIZW/d6projdata")

sapply(list("sf", "tidyverse", "terra", "here", "ggplot2", "patchwork", "d6projdata", "mapview", "cowplot"), 
       library, character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE)
```

# Data

```{r data}
data <- rast()

data_name <- d6projdata::proj_data_name(x = data)

if(!base::dir.exists(paths = here::here("data", data_name))){
    base::dir.create(path = here::here("data", data_name),
                     showWarnings = TRUE,
                     recursive = TRUE)}

```

# create proj data file

```{r}
proj_data <- tibble(proj_name = data_name, 
      proj_id = NA,
      Dep = NA,
      sup_vis = NA,
      data_file_name = NA,
      data_name_archive = NA,
      edited_unique_identifier = NA,
      original_unique_identifier = NA,
      study_country = NA,
      study_area = NA,
      species =NA,
      type_of_sample = NA,
      type_of_data = NA,
      type_of_measure = NA,
      repeated_measure = c("yes", "no")[utils::menu(c("yes", 
        "no"), title = "repeated measure?")], 
      no_spec = NA,
      no_ind = NA,
      data_from = NA, 
      data_to = NA, 
      additional_info = NA,
      publication = NA,
      publication_doi = NA,
      metadata_description = NA,
      temporal_resolution_sec = NA,
      temporal_resolution_min = NA,
      IZW_archive_path = NA,
      IZW_data_path = NA,
      external_archives = NA,
      movebank_id = NA,
      tva_number = NA,
      euromammal_id = NA,
      sample_data = NA,
      proc_data = NA,
      cooperation = NA,
      data_owner = NA,
      projection = sf::st_crs(crs(data_ras))$proj4string, 
      EPSG_code = as.character(sf::st_crs(crs(data_ras))$epsg), 
      data_type = NA)


openxlsx::write.xlsx(x = proj_data, file = here::here("data", 
    proj_data$proj_name, paste0("meta_data_", proj_data$proj_name, 
      ".xlsx")), overwrite = TRUE)

proj_data <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data", data_name, paste0("meta_data_", data_name, ".xlsx"))) %>% 
  mutate(data_from = as.character(min(as.Date(data_from, 
            origin = "1970-01-01"))),
         data_to = as.character(max(as.Date(data_to, 
            origin = "1970-01-01"))))
```

# move data

```{r}
d6projdata::fun_move_raw(data_name = data_name,
                         data_path = here(
    "data", "unsortiert"))
```

# save data

```{r}
writeRaster(data, here::here("data", data_name, "processed", paste0(data_name, ".tif")))
```

# render data

```{r}
data_plot <- data |> project("epsg:4326")

d6projdata::render_projdata_ras(
  path = here::here("data",
                    data_name),
  data_name = data_name,
  data_ras = data_plot,
  data = data, 
  proj_data = proj_data,
  id_col = ""
)
```
